intro-3-1.text: Foundry. In there the Anvil beats stolen light into ships. So stay close. Nobody flies this one alone.

after-2-1.text: The salt's shining again. Behind us, anyway.

after-4-2.text: They're falling toward Heartfall. And after Heartfall, we go home.

ending-tevi.text: Good flying, all of you. First round back home is mine.
